enable_testing()

macro(add_dxfrw_test test_name file)
    add_executable(${test_name} ${file})
    target_link_libraries(${test_name} PRIVATE dxfrw)
    target_include_directories(${test_name} PRIVATE ../src .)
    add_test(NAME ${test_name} COMMAND ${test_name})
    set_target_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES FOLDER "vendor/dxf")
endmacro()

add_dxfrw_test(test_basic test_basic.cpp)
add_dxfrw_test(test_entities test_entities.cpp)
add_dxfrw_test(test_polylines test_polylines.cpp)
add_dxfrw_test(test_text test_text.cpp)
add_dxfrw_test(test_tables test_tables.cpp)
add_dxfrw_test(test_blocks test_blocks.cpp)
add_dxfrw_test(test_versions test_versions.cpp)
add_dxfrw_test(test_errors test_errors.cpp)
add_dxfrw_test(test_dimensions test_dimensions.cpp)
add_dxfrw_test(test_annotations test_annotations.cpp)
add_dxfrw_test(test_attributes test_attributes.cpp)
add_dxfrw_test(test_class_underflow test_class_underflow.cpp)
add_dxfrw_test(test_dwg_classes test_dwg_classes.cpp)
